title: skill-advisories adoption ledger
description: Independently verifiable downstream integrations. Registry downloads are deliberately absent: a download is not a dependent, and this file records only integrations a third party can check.

name.description: The adopting project, as it calls itself.

url.description: Public link at which the integration itself can be seen -- a workflow file, a config, a dependency manifest. Not a homepage.

consent.description: How the adopter agreed to be listed. public-link: the integration is public and speaks for itself. maintainer-stated: a maintainer said so somewhere citable.

consent_url.description: Where that consent can be read. Required for an entry to count towards the adoption gate.

recorded.description: When this entry was added, ISO 8601.

verified.description: Whether a maintainer has followed the links and confirmed the integration is real and current. An unverified entry is kept but never counted.
